audit_kind: exact-commit read-only static audit with separately identified cross-run evidence
provenance: Source inspected via git show 91618843a4:path. Current origin/main contains the target; its three-dot diff is empty, so the explicitly named historical PR parent is reported separately. No code changes, no GPU run.

notation.K: distinct owner + exact HUD world-position groups

call_root.call: PresenterEntityTransformSyncSystem registered before Behavior:2523, Animator:2524, Emit:2528
hudProjection.Update(dt) after engine.Tick; HUD projection is adapter post work, not inside GameEngine presentation system loop

timeline.change: Adds Sampled==0 owner-height provenance guard to individual and batch grounding scheduling, originally PerformerEntityRuntime. This is the semantic introduction, found using git log --follow -G and git show.
Performer renamed to Presenter; not the semantic introduction.
VisualHeightmap naming changed to ContinuousHeightmap. git blame:1958 points here, but this rename did not introduce the condition.
Adds terrain visibility work to world-HUD projection. Correctness improvement has an additional ray-query cost.
Integrates Presenter owner/child transform fast paths and retained HUD direct update work. BehaviorSystem itself is unchanged from the historical PR baseline.
Required audited target. Historical diff of these four systems: transform sync, emit, HUD changed; BehaviorSystem unchanged.

Separate branch commit present in ffd merge, absent from 916: deletes individual owner Sampled==0 scheduling guard. Graph ancestry, not author-date sorting, determines presence. BatchRequiresGroundingTick:2059 still has a separate guard; not assumed fixed by this one-line change.

findings.title: 首次采样状态被用来选择长期行为队列，10K 单位保留每帧工作
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed mechanism plus two-launch counter/timing A/B; not a frame-paired whole-machine causal estimate.
findings.call_chain: Presenter creation/behavior activation -> AddBehaviorMarkers:1712 or SyncTickBehaviorMarkers:1444 -> GroundingRequiresPresenterTick:1928 -> CanUseOwnerHeightmapSampleForSnapToGround:1947 rejects Sampled==0 -> SyncTickBehaviorMarker<PerfHasGrounding>:1562 -> each GameEngine.Update -> PresenterBehaviorSystem.Update:198 -> _tickDrivenQuery:94 -> ProcessTickDrivenPresenters:667. Homogeneous eligible chunks can cheaply skip height work; mixed-definition chunks go through ProcessPresenter:906, CaptureWorldTransform:932, ResolveTransform:962 and ApplyGrounding:984 before its owner-sample skip.
findings.trigger: Entity-anchored zero-offset EveryFrame SnapToGround presenter; owner has VisualTransform and ContinuousHeightmapSampleState; PresenterTransformSource=EntityTransform; owner.Sampled==0 when markers are synchronized. The presence of the component expresses owner grounding capability, while Sampled expresses transient readiness. TerrainHeightSync later changes Sampled, but does not call SyncTickBehaviorMarkers to reclassify presenters.
findings.frequency_per_frame: Marker decision occurs at creation/activation refresh. Thereafter each erroneously marked presenter remains in the tick query: observed 10000/frame at 916, 0/frame in ffd reference. Homogeneous chunks still scan to validate definitions and skip grounding; mixed definitions may process individually.
findings.complexity: O(P_tick * (component reads + active tick behaviors)); no N². Work can remain even when height sampling is skipped.

gc.steady: No inherent allocation from the marker check or span loops. General ProcessPresenter depends on configured bindings; graph lane is separate PRES-08.
gc.first_or_growth: Archetype/command capacity during marker setup and grounding staging first-use growth may allocate.

findings.ecs_structure: PerfHasGrounding add/remove changes archetype at scheduling time. Runtime marker helper uses a CommandBuffer when deferred scope is bound; ordinary steady frames only retain the marker. Removing a marker every frame is not an acceptable replacement design.
findings.capacity: ECS/chunk capacities are elsewhere. Grounding stage uses nine arrays grown from at least 256 via doubling. BatchRequiresGroundingTick:2059 retains its own Sampled guard and requires separate coverage.
findings.impact_10k: Parent's same-model experimental application runs switch behaviorTick 0 -> 10000 and approximately 0.01 -> 5.16–5.18ms in quiet sampled frames. Filtered full-log aggregates are attached separately; all filters and confounds must remain visible.

ab.method: Create otherwise identical owners before their first height sample versus after Sampled=1. Record marker count at creation, after first sample, and after 120 frames. Compare exact 916 and reference with only 1958 removed in isolated experiments, while keeping geometry/config/camera and sampled owner counts fixed. Include mixed/homogeneous presenter definition chunks and the batch creation API.
ab.falsifier: If tick marker count follows Sampled transition automatically or the counts/timing do not change with the one-line scheduling guard, the latch explanation is incomplete.

findings.history: Condition introduced d92aa08d69; retained in 916; individual scheduling correction 951f77bb6d only in reference merge.
findings.expected_budget_release_ms: About 5ms is supported as a workload-specific candidate from the separate launches. No exact whole-frame saving or FPS guarantee; confirm with paired controlled runs.

findings.title: HUD 全量投影触发逐位置地形射线
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed added work; isolated ray count and time unmeasured.
findings.call_chain: RaylibHostLoop:681 -> WorldHudToScreenSystem.Update -> revision invalidation -> full WorldHudItem span scan -> IsOwnerVisible -> coarse cull -> TryGetOwnerFrameProjection -> ProjectWorldToScreenFast -> IsTerrainVisible -> IContinuousHeightmap.TryRaycastGround -> concrete provider (ContinuousHeightmapRuntime:139 -> ContinuousHeightmapQueries:137; VertexMapContinuousHeightmap:79 -> ray marching:249).
findings.frequency_per_frame: One full scan when camera, HUD projection, culling visibility or terrain revision changes. Per eligible owner+exact world-position cache miss one ray. Adjacent items with the same owner AND position share one ray; cache stores only the last position per owner, so differing bar/text anchor heights or interleaving can raise calls toward H, not necessarily N. Revisions unchanged: O(1) early exit; content-only dirty updates bypass projection.
findings.complexity: O(H + K*R). Exact terrain provider traverses ray-intersected cells; marching provider performs bounded steps/refinement. VertexMap marching clamps steps 8..2048. No evidence of N×obstacle loop here.

gc.steady: No direct managed allocation in projection/ray setup; owner caches must already cover entity IDs. Concrete provider allocation must be independently measured.
gc.first_or_growth: Owner visibility/projection arrays resize, see PRES-03.

findings.ecs_structure: None; only reads owner CullState and writes HUD buffers.
findings.capacity: HUD buffers fixed capacity, owner caches unbounded doubling. Ray API has no target-distance parameter, so IsTerrainVisible asks for a general ground hit then compares hit.DistanceMeters to targetDistance. Traversal work beyond required visibility interval may remain provider-dependent.
findings.impact_10k: 10K owners and 20K HUD items can create O(10K–20K) terrain queries on moving/full-projection frames. Current experimental application hudProj around 9–15ms is contextual evidence; it is not the measured ray-query share at an unmodified 916 baseline.

ab.method: At 1K/5K/10K compare fixed camera/static units, moving units, camera-only movement; instrument ray count, cells/steps and cache hits. Toggle only HUD occlusion in an isolated experiment while preserving ground rendering and unit grounding. Verify hidden-behind-terrain correctness in both paths before accepting any replacement.
ab.falsifier: If ray count is low or disabling/replacing ray work does not reduce projection time, projection buffer/index work is the dominant cost.

findings.history: Terrain visibility addition is 0f1036ba53. Projection retention/cache paths also predate that change.

findings.title: HUD 缓存按最大实体 ID 扩容，稳定帧与容量帧表现不同
findings.evidence_status: Source confirmed capacity contract risk; no steady-frame GC attributed.
findings.call_chain: HUD.Update -> IsOwnerVisible -> SetOwnerVisible -> Array.Resize; independently CacheOwnerFrameProjection -> Array.Resize. ResolveOwnerCacheKey uses owner.Id+1. Frame stamps invalidate logically; arrays clear only on int.MaxValue wrap.
findings.frequency_per_frame: Two possible growth events when the largest encountered owner key exceeds each cache; zero growth after warmup until a larger entity ID appears. No per-frame full array clear except stamp wrap approximately once in 2.1 billion projection rebuilds.
findings.complexity: Stable O(1) lookup; growth O(new maximum entity ID) allocation/zeroing/copy; memory depends on max ID, not live N.

gc.first_or_growth: Array.Resize allocates replacement arrays and copies old content. Capacity doubles from 1024 with no configured cap.

findings.capacity: Unbounded int doubling until memory/array/runtime limits, not explicit configured failure. Long-lived sessions with many effect/presenter entities can make max owner ID much larger than N.
findings.impact_10k: Can produce startup/spawn spikes and excess retained memory even with few HUD owners; it does not explain stable 10K milliseconds by itself.

ab.method: Compare identical 10K HUD owners with dense low IDs and IDs after a large throwaway entity population. Measure initial allocations/peak cache length separately from 120 warmed frames; repeat at capacity and capacity+1.
ab.falsifier: If IDs are kept within prewarmed arrays, this is not a source of recurring frame allocations.

findings.history: Cache behavior retained at target; do not label Array.Clear:597 as every-frame work.

findings.title: Transform 同步用 Chunk 读本体，但跨 owner/presenter 的访问仍然逐实体
findings.evidence_status: Source confirmed; performance share pending controlled A/B.
findings.call_chain: GameEngine.Update -> TransformSync.Update -> SyncSingleRootOwnerPayloads -> spans over owner WorldPosition/VisualTransform/payload -> 6 Has checks plus state Has/Get and 5 individual Get calls on root presenter -> compare/update -> MarkEmitDirty -> SyncFastAttachedChildren. If any owner changes, SyncOwnerPayloadAttachedChildren scans its entire query and fetches parent transform tuple per child. Separate EntityAnchoredQuery reads owner Has/Get individually.
findings.frequency_per_frame: Every eligible owner is checked, static or moving. If any root changed, all eligible owner-payload attached children are scanned, not only children of changed owners. A health bar and text each fetch their parent transform.
findings.complexity: O(N + P_entityAnchored + C_children when any root changed + changed hierarchy edges). No global N²; cache locality of cross-entity lookups remains.

gc.steady: No direct allocation in these loops.
gc.first_or_growth: Dirty retained queue can grow, see PRES-05.

findings.ecs_structure: Component writes are nonstructural. MarkEmitDirty can reach scheduling marker creation on a missing-marker transition, see PRES-09.
findings.capacity: No local growing storage. Parent child limits and runtime queue capacities are external; dirty queue unbounded doubles.
findings.impact_10k: ~70K Has and 60K Get operations are present per 10K single-root owners before dirty propagation in the common state-present branch, plus up to 20K parent tuple fetches for two child HUD presenters. Counts are source-derived, not sampled.

ab.method: Measure 0%,1%,100% moved owners with 0/1/2 attached children, using same camera/culling. Compare existing scan to a configured SoA dense owner-to-root mapping and generation-validated dirty owner list in temporary worktree; no unsafe persistent ref caching. Count Has/Get and total child scans.
ab.falsifier: If Has/Get consolidation or restricting child work yields no measurable difference, this is not a meaningful frame-budget opportunity.

findings.history: ac8ab86af0 adds optimized child chunk path while retaining cross-entity parent fetches. Existing Chunk/Span usage is a positive, not a missing optimization.

findings.title: 移动或血量变化后，HUD 脏队列再逐实体读取并复制条目
findings.evidence_status: Source confirmed linear work and capacity behavior; not a measured root cause.
findings.call_chain: TransformSync or dirty owner bindings -> Runtime.Mark*EmitDirty -> MarkRetainedPresentationRequestDirty flag deduplication -> AppendRetainedPresentationDirtyEntity -> Emit.Update -> ProcessDirtyRetainedPresentationRequestEntities -> ProcessRetainedPresentationDirtyList -> position-only direct update or component gather + TryUpdateRetainedWorldHudDirect -> WorldHudBatchBuffer.UpdatePosition/TryAdd -> Runtime.ClearStaticDirty -> ClearConsumedRetainedPresentationDirtyEntities.
findings.frequency_per_frame: D dirty presenters per frame; flags deduplicate while dirty. Position-only path still reads emit cache and world position, and ClearStaticDirty fetches cache again. Content/full direct path fetches state,cull,position,rotation,facing,scale individually. Queue clears D Entity values after consumption.
findings.complexity: O(D * cross-entity reads + D * required-attribute comparison + output copy). Cached phase projection only reuses the immediately preceding matching owner/LOD/required attributes, not all owner groups.

gc.steady: 0 B when arrays/dictionaries warm. Array.Empty<int> reset is singleton, not an allocation; WorldHudItem construction is a struct.
gc.first_or_growth: Retained queue Array.Resize doubles from 256; WorldHud stable-ID Dictionary first key/resize allocates. ClearConsumed uses Array.Clear but Entity is a value type; it is O(D) writes without allocation.

findings.ecs_structure: Dirty flags/buffer changes nonstructural on the direct retained path.
findings.capacity: Runtime retained queue has no configured bound or explicit cap. WorldHud buffer fixed; direct update throws on capacity failure at Emit:524-528.
findings.impact_10k: With two moving HUD child presenters, D can reach 20K each frame. SoA ECS storage is gathered into an AoS WorldHudItem buffer, then scanned/projected again. Existing direct and position-only shortcuts already remove substantial work; their hit rate must be measured.

ab.method: Record D, position-only/direct/full path hits, phase projection reuses and emitted HUD changes for still+effects, moving+effects off, moving+effects on. Compare owner-interleaved versus owner-adjacent dirty order; compare generation-stamped queue versus zeroing value array while preserving dedup and lifetime identity.
ab.falsifier: If D is small or position-only path already dominates with low CPU, the candidate benefit is small.

findings.history: Direct retained HUD changes included ac8ab86af0. Queue and value-array clear retained behavior.

findings.title: 持续属性事件按 owner 展开到各个 Presenter，再查相同属性工作
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed indexed fan-out; not a linear search over all units.
findings.call_chain: GAS/presentation owner-change publication -> PresentationOwnerChangeBuffer -> Behavior.Update -> ProcessOwnerChanges -> ProcessOwnerAttributeChange -> Dictionary owner bucket -> each presenter -> definition lookup -> binary search compiled attribute work -> ApplyOwnerAttributeWork -> SetParam -> dirty retained outputs.
findings.frequency_per_frame: One entry per published owner attribute/tag event, then each presenter for that owner. No dedup shown in PresentationOwnerChangeBuffer itself. Current bar/text definitions bind Health ratio/current/base; their work executes on change events, not by polling all 10K every frame.
findings.complexity: O(E * (A_owner * log W + active binding work)), where E event entries and A_owner attached presenter count. Owner-to-presenter lookup expected O(1), compiled attribute search O(log W); not O(N²).

gc.steady: No direct allocation in standard attribute work lookup. Param storage behavior depends on precreated slots.
gc.first_or_growth: Definition index refresh at version change builds List/ToArray and dictionaries; it is not repeated per steady frame. Owner bucket creation/resizing occurs in lifecycle.

findings.ecs_structure: Behavior wraps runtime mutations in CommandBuffer; dirty param updates may schedule material markers. Buffer publication itself nonstructural.
findings.capacity: PresentationOwnerChangeBuffer fixed constructor capacity; TryAdd increments Dropped counters and returns false at capacity. Caller handling must be traced before claiming explicit failure. Does not grow itself.
findings.impact_10k: Continuous effect cadence determines E; provided runtime windows commonly show ~170 changed owners, far below 10K, so this should not be credited with the 10000 behaviorTick delta.

ab.method: At each population hold transforms still and toggle continuous Health effects; record E, unique owner+attribute count, per-owner presenter count, binding writes and dirty HUD items. Compare event cadence and duplicate same-owner/same-attribute events with identical final health values.
ab.falsifier: If event counts stay low and Behavior cost remains after effects off, owner-change processing is not dominant.

findings.history: PresenterBehaviorSystem unchanged between historical PR base and target.

findings.title: Skinned 发射每帧写 AoS 条目，但清空只重置计数
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed layout/work; no measured cache penalty and no proven duplicate draw here.
findings.call_chain: Emit.Update -> _skinnedVisualBatchBuffer.Clear (count reset) -> EmitQuery chunk spans -> fast visual definition -> EmitVisualProxyFast -> TryEmitSkinnedVisualBatchFast -> resolve asset/material/animator -> append SkinnedVisualBatchItem -> adapter reads span.
findings.frequency_per_frame: One full struct write per visible active skinned asset binding per presenter each presentation frame, even when transforms are stationary because animation can vary. Typical 10K one-binding path yields 10K writes.
findings.complexity: O(P_visible * A_assetBindings + parameter lookups). Asset swap table scans are linear in that table, not in unit count.

gc.steady: Struct item construction and counter Clear are 0 B. No array clearing/copy in Clear; Array.Empty and new value structs must not be counted as managed allocations.
gc.first_or_growth: Buffer is allocated once with constructor capacity. No buffer growth.

findings.ecs_structure: Normal fast emission nonstructural; lifecycle destruction is separate PRES-09.
findings.capacity: SkinnedVisualBatchBuffer default constructor capacity 4096; engine configuration can supply another value. TryAdd false increments dropped counters; fast Emit throws explicitly:1605-1608. Exact 10K runtime configured capacity must be read from launch config, not inferred from default.
findings.impact_10k: AoS payload includes transform, color, animator, metadata and overlay fields, all rebuilt/copy-appended per active unit. This is a potential bandwidth cost, not proof AoS causes current slowdown. The main ECS iteration already uses Chunk/Span and AnimatorSlot spans.

ab.method: Measure emitted item count, append/copy bytes and time with animator static/off/on; compare a temporary fixed-capacity SoA emission snapshot retaining equivalent fields and order. Verify no main or shadow membership changes and no extra layer submissions.
ab.falsifier: If changing payload layout/copy work does not change CPU time, retain current path; do not infer duplicate drawing from names.

findings.history: Fast paths integrated by ac8ab86af0; no assertion that this path creates the reported mesh ghost.

findings.title: Graph 参数路径即使成功也分配说明字符串，并逐次清整组寄存器
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed allocation in successful graph path; not shown active in MassNavigation definitions.
findings.call_chain: Behavior.Update -> ProcessTickDrivenPresenters -> ProcessPresenter -> ApplyGraphParamBindings -> graph binding evaluation -> constructs bindingPath interpolated string unconditionally -> ProgramWritesFloatResultRegister -> SeedGraphInputRegisters -> clears float/int/bool/entity/callstack arrays -> walks parameter ancestry -> GraphExecutor.Execute.
findings.frequency_per_frame: Once per executed graph binding; continuous lane can be per presenter/frame. Zero executions when graph bindings absent.
findings.complexity: O(G * (program length scan + register capacity + ancestry params + graph instructions)), G graph binding executions.

gc.steady: bindingPath interpolation at 1410 allocates a new string on successful graph evaluation. This is not limited to warning/error branch.
gc.first_or_growth: HashSet warnings also grow on first distinct warning; error interpolation may allocate additional strings.

findings.ecs_structure: Param/marker updates use Behavior deferred scope when called through normal Update.
findings.capacity: Graph register arrays fixed at GraphVmLimits. Warning HashSets have no configured cap. Failure paths warn and retain blackboard values at 1414/1451/1457, contrary to requested no-fallback policy for new fixes.
findings.impact_10k: Would break 0Alloc if enabled for 10K presenters. A source search of MassNavigation presenter configuration did not show graph bindings; do not assign this cost to current 10K evidence.

ab.method: Run a minimal valid graph parameter binding 1K/5K/10K with no errors; measure current-thread allocated bytes and graph call counts. Move diagnostic message construction to error path in a temporary A/B and compare. Separately profile register seeding, preserving NaN/zero semantic contracts.
ab.falsifier: If graph execution count is zero in MassNavigation, this finding has no direct frame cost there.

findings.history: Retained pre-PR behavior, not introduced by the target diff.

findings.title: 仍有结构变更边界：缺失发射标记与销毁尾部
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed conditional mutation; not evidence of every-frame archetype churn in 10K.
findings.call_chain: TransformSync -> MarkTransform(Position)DrivenEmitDirty -> EnsureRequestBackedEmitWorkScheduled -> AddMarker<PerfHasEmitWork> -> immediate World.Add when no deferred scope. Separately Emit.Update queues dead/expired presenter in _pendingDestroy, then Runtime.Destroy recursively unlinks/removes indexes and calls World.Destroy after query loops.
findings.frequency_per_frame: Only missing-marker transitions or presenter destruction/lifetime events. Stable alive scene with initialized markers need not perform any structure changes.
findings.complexity: O(number of transitions * archetype move work + destroyed hierarchy size).

gc.first_or_growth: _pendingDestroy List initial capacity 256 can expand; ECS destination chunks, index maintenance and CommandBuffer growth can allocate on lifecycle bursts.

findings.ecs_structure: Yes. Behavior has explicit CommandBuffer deferral. TransformSync is scheduled before that scope and Emit.Destroy executes after query traversal but not through a shared finalization CommandBuffer.
findings.capacity: No configured _pendingDestroy list cap. ECS and runtime child/index capacities external. AddMarker falls directly to World.Add instead of throwing when scope absent.
findings.impact_10k: Mass deaths, spawning or reactivation can produce spikes; stable navigation cannot be blamed without mutation counters. Existing GameEngine also registers a separate presentation finalization stage at 2532, so ownership/order of destruction should be reviewed before moving mutations.

ab.method: Instrument Create/Add/Remove/Destroy counts and archetype version deltas per stage. Use no-lifecycle baseline, 1% turnover, 10K batch destruction and missing-marker reactivation; compare explicit finalization CommandBuffer with identical lifecycle callbacks and resource ownership.
ab.falsifier: Zero structural mutation count on slow steady frames excludes this as their cause.

findings.history: Retained runtime lifecycle behavior. Do not claim Behavior violates query-safety merely because its deferred playback changes structure.

findings.title: Screen HUD 超限沿投影路径丢条目，未显式失败
findings.evidence_status: Source-confirmed overflow behavior; no drops observed in supplied 20K run.
findings.call_chain: HUD.Update -> ProjectAdjacentOwnerItems -> ProjectSingleItem -> TryUpsertProjectedBar/Text -> ScreenHud.TryAddBar/Text returns false and increments dropped counters -> caller increments attempted output index and continues without exception.
findings.frequency_per_frame: Only when projected retained/transient items exceed shared _flattened capacity. At 20K items with default 65536 no expected overflow.

gc.steady: Fixed arrays and preallocated stable dictionaries support zero allocation below capacity.
gc.first_or_growth: ScreenHud constructor allocates multiple arrays/dictionaries for capacity; no ordinary auto-resize of item arrays.

findings.capacity: Constructor-configurable fixed capacity (default 65536); overflow reported by counters and false, but projection does not surface an explicit error. This differs from direct retained world HUD and skinned Emit paths that throw.
findings.impact_10k: Correctness/capacity contract, not demonstrated performance loss at current counts. A misleadingly lower item count could otherwise appear faster after overflow.

ab.method: Use configured capacity-1, capacity, capacity+1 projected items; verify explicit failure, projected count, dropped counters and stable retained removal semantics. Run 1K/5K/10K with capacity sufficient so performance comparison never relies on dropped HUD.
ab.falsifier: Observed screenHudDrops=0 means overflow does not explain that run.

confirmed_non_findings: All four inspected Update hot loops use ReadOnlySpan or ECS Chunk/GetSpan and direct for/foreach iteration. No World.Query delegate closure or LINQ was identified in their normal hot loops. Existing constructor Func delegates are invoked, not recreated per frame.
World/Screen HUD and skinned output buffers are AoS structs; ECS component access via Chunk/GetSpan is column-oriented. Neither using Span nor a suspect class name alone proves a performance problem.

No entity-to-index full linear search or all-unit×all-unit/all-obstacle scan found in these four systems. Owner buckets use Dictionary keys containing full owner identity; definition attribute work uses binary search.
WorldHud cache stamp wrap Array.Clear and ScreenHud projected stamp wrap Clear are extremely infrequent, not per-frame array clears.
SkinnedVisualBatchBuffer.Clear and PresentationOwnerChangeBuffer.Clear reset count/counters only; do not clear full arrays.
Bootstrap/definition refresh List/ToArray allocations and staging growth are first-use/change events; stable 0B observations do not prove all capacity paths are allocation-free.
Owner-backed grounding skip already avoids repeated actual height queries after sample readiness, even while an incorrect tick marker continues to cost component work.

required_measurements_status.completed_in_this_subtask: Read-only exact-source audit, historical diffs/blame, image-independent source verification, and parsing parent-provided application logs.
not_completed: Unmodified 916 whole-machine 1K/5K/10K factorial or balanced A/B matrix
per-frame current-thread allocation and Gen0/Gen1 for these four exact-source paths in application
terrain query and ray sample counts
same-seed paired regression run of 1958 guard
required_measurements_status.matrix: At each N=1K/5K/10K compare still/moving and sparse/crowded; independently toggle HUD, terrain occlusion, Animator, MassNavigation, periodic Effect, Minimap. Each comparison preserves camera/view/population/seed and records total, simulation, presentation, post-HUD separately.
required_measurements_status.warning: Experimental red/blue mannequin/GPU changes in the parent launches mean log totals are not a clean original Knight/916 whole-machine baseline; do not combine them with local GPU microbench timings.

minimal_fix_order: First validate the durable grounding scheduling contract against both individual and batch creation, late terrain readiness, failures and static owners. Use existing owner terrain capability to select lane; preserve grounding readiness correctness. No hot-frame marker toggling.

Measure HUD per-owner+position terrain rays and provider traversal share; replace repeated work only with a bounded, correctness-equivalent visibility query/cache, not an occlusion-off production shortcut.
Preallocate configured HUD owner/retained queue capacities with explicit overflow behavior; distinguish this capacity reliability fix from steady-frame speedups.
Consolidate cross-entity transform/HUD work into generation-safe SoA/Chunk/Span batches if A/B verifies a benefit; retain model/HUD ownership and projection correctness.
Move diagnostic graph strings to failure-only construction if that lane is in scope; instrument relevant configurations before claiming 10K benefit.
remaining_frame_budget: Only the behavior scheduling difference has a source-supported application timing signal (~5ms in quiet cross-run samples). HUD projection remains substantial after it. All other release estimates are null until isolated A/B; remaining simulation/presentation/adapter/GPU/wait work is outside this four-system static audit.
